summary: Feed s078_single to IDS is degraded: 74.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the IDS tolerance of 60%. All other visibility checks (duplicates, VLANs, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 74.5% of traffic by bytes is TLS/encrypted (threshold 60% for this IDS). Packet broker is forwarding encrypted sessions directly to the IDS without prior decryption or selective plaintext forwarding, so payload remains opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With ~74% encrypted bytes, the IDS is blind to most application-layer attacks, malware C2, and exploit payloads, significantly reducing detection coverage despite healthy delivery on other metrics.

params.suggestion: enable selective SSL/TLS decryption or mirror decrypted traffic from SSL visibility appliance

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting or selectively forwarding decrypted traffic will bring encrypted share below 60% and restore payload visibility the IDS needs for full signature matching, without changing TAP/SPAN or load-balancing.
